definitions.explanation: The process of producing alcoholic beverages (sake, beer, wine) or fermented foods (soy sauce, miso, vinegar) through controlled fermentation.

examples.japanese: この{蔵|くら}では{日本酒|にほんしゅ}を{醸造|じょうぞう}している。
ビールの{醸造|じょうぞう}{工程|こうてい}を{見学|けんがく}した。
examples.english: I toured the beer brewing process.

examples.japanese: {醸造|じょうぞう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{何百年|なんびゃくねん}もかけて{磨|みが}かれてきた。
examples.english: Brewing techniques have been refined over hundreds of years.

notes:
A compound of {醸|じょう} (to brew, to ferment) and {造|ぞう} (to make, to create). Functions as both a noun and a suru-verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {醸造|じょうぞう}する (to brew, to ferment)
- {醸造所|じょうぞうしょ} (brewery)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}{技術|ぎじゅつ} (brewing technique)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}{酢|す} (brewed vinegar)
- {醸造|じょうぞう}{酒|しゅ} (brewed alcohol — as opposed to distilled)

Covers a broader range than the English "brewing" since it includes the fermentation of soy sauce ({醤油|しょうゆ}), miso ({味噌|みそ}), and vinegar ({酢|す}) in addition to alcoholic beverages. Japan has a long tradition of {醸造|じょうぞう} culture, with many regional breweries and fermented food producers.
